result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts`:

- `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`.
- `createDownloadLink` sets `expiresAt` to 7 days after creation, as an ISO timestamp.
- The URL now includes it as `?token=...&expires=<URL-encoded ISO timestamp>`.

Nothing else in the repo uses `DownloadLink` or `createDownloadLink`, so there were no other callers to update.

This only adds the timestamp to the link. Nothing checks `expires` yet. To make links actually expire, whatever serves the download has to reject requests past that time. Because the timestamp is a plain query parameter, anyone could edit it unless the server also signs it or looks the expiry up by token.
